title: 面向中小企业的AI驱动绿色ESG评估框架
summary: 提出一种基于AI的框架，用于评估欧洲中小企业的环境、社会和治理（ESG）表现。该系统利用n8n自动化平台构建AI代理，基于专家验证的基线分数进行自动ESG分类，并利用大语言模型生成上下文建议。结果显示AI系统与人工输出高度一致，支持更有效的监控和干预策略。
summary_en: This study presents an AI-driven framework for assessing ESG performance in European SMEs. An AI agent system built on n8n uses expert-validated baselines for automated ESG classification and LLM-generated recommendations, showing high consistency with human outputs to support the European Green Deal.
